d: Ellis Emmett's first stop is the Kingdom of Tonga  he befriends a local named Lofi, and the two set sail for the isolated island of Tofua  they explore a newly formed volcanic island, navigate treacherous coral reefs, and must hunt for their dinner.
Ellis sets sail for the islands of Fiji, where he faces bull sharks, partakes in ancient Fijian fire walking rituals and anchors in the remote Lau Islands.
Ellis has a brush with royalty on the island kingdoms of Wallis and Futuna.
Ellis explores the Marshall Islands and examines the continuing aftermath of World War II.
Ellis helps get a traditional canoe back on the water and sees how rising seas are changing life in the island chains of Kiribati.
Savanna and Jace have a specific request before they say I Do in Punta Cana: a beach wedding with no sand!
Two families come together for the first time to see the bride and groom say I Do in Cancun.

t: Small Town, Big Story: The Town of Storytellers
d: Visiting the storytelling capital of the world, where the town itself and everyone in it have a story to tell.
